description: This file defines the GeminiService class, which interfaces with the Google Generative AI API to perform chat-based AI tasks, including generating responses, summarizing documents, and creating session titles. It utilizes environment variables for API keys and handles search result formatting, conversation history, and safety configurations.

classes.name: GeminiService
classes.description: A service class for interacting with Google Generative AI API, handling configuration, prompt construction, and response generation for various chatbot functionalities.

methods.name: __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes GeminiService by configuring the API key, model, safety settings, and generation parameters.

methods.name: str _format_context(self, search_results: List[SearchResult])
methods.description: Formats a list of search results into a string context suitable for prompt inclusion.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,str]] _build_conversation_history(self, messages: List[ChatMessage])
methods.description: Builds a list of conversation turns for context, using the last 10 messages.

methods.name: str generate_response( self, user_message: str, context: Optional[List[SearchResult]] = None, conversation_history: Optional[List[ChatMessage]] = None )
methods.description: Generates a response to a user message, optionally considering search context and conversation history.

methods.name: str generate_session_title(self, first_message: str, response: str)
methods.description: Creates a concise descriptive title for a chat session based on an exchange.

methods.name: str summarize_document(self, text: str, max_length: int = 500)
methods.description: Produces a brief summary of a provided document text.
